ChildReference.description: Select one exact child request in this proposal. The request maps to a complete retained Plan; a UUID without that binding is not an executable target.

RequestBinding.description: One exact child request with a complete reviewed Plan, assigned to an installed procedure phase. Initial ready Plans are the first request for their participant and use its initial expected_generation. Later reviewed Plans are retained through workflow.bind, with current independently verified preconditions. The Plan owner and subject resource match its participant; every effect remains within the immutable participant closure. adapter.execute requires the complete approved AdapterInput; other actions forbid it. Ordinary child evidence must match its exact owner, request, Plan and the enclosing workflow ID in the Operation witness at binding, phase advancement and recovery alike; standalone or unrelated-workflow success cannot fulfill it.

HostDrainTarget.description: The exact host change whose reviewed Plan binds disruption, live scope and recovery. Participant Plans contain all admitted application draining and reconciliation work.

InterfaceBindingTarget.description: The exact typed application provider deployment, upgrade or repair Plan and each intended consumer Plan bind the reviewed interface configuration through their retained release/input material. Native phase admission verifies the produced binding and each consumer obligation.

IngressPublicationTarget.description: The publication child is adapter.execute with the exact approved ingress executor and fishhat.ingress publish AdapterInput, retaining complete candidate routes and expected generation. An unrelated mutation method cannot satisfy this role.

SecretRotationTarget.description: The ready issuer_change is the exact credential-issuer issue child. publication is a secret-publication continuation for that issuer, in the installed publishing phase. Every consumer_adoption is a secret-adoption continuation referring to those same issuer and publisher children. Real output material is bound only after it exists and is independently verified, reviewed and retained. Preparation never invents a future receipt.

CheckpointTarget.description: The exact capture Plan, including the accepted source and complete native data/secret/release recovery inputs. Capture is distinct from a successful restore drill.

RelocationTarget.description: The exact relocation Plan binds the source application identity, destination, fencing and checkpoint or release recovery basis.

SourcePublicationTarget.description: The exact source.publish Plan binds the intended source, base and complete proposal content before a client can disappear.

DnsChangeTarget.description: The exact dns.reconcile Plan binds the complete changeset and approved provider scope.

SecretPublicationTarget.description: The exact publisher publication or recovery Plan binds the immutable secret candidate and selected predecessor.

RawMaintenanceTarget.description: The exact reviewed maintenance Plan binds the admitted task or approved adapter method, its scope, expected disruption and reconciliation. This target is not a caller-supplied command or procedure graph.

RuntimeUpgradeTarget.description: The exact host.runtime-install Plan binds the management release, selected tools and state-preserving migration scope.

WorkflowProposal.description: The immutable installed procedure, participant/resource closure, initial driver agreement and child request slots. A ready child retains its complete reviewed Plan and material; a closed continuation intent retains exact scope, predecessor and allowed action without inventing future material or a stale future Plan. Every receiver independently authorizes the full local closure and initial driver, and pins existing local content before preparation. Other participants retain the same proposal digest. Later reviewed Plans and actual output material are attached only by workflow.bind under current authority and exact retained lineage; this does not edit the proposal or admit a child effect. Stored initial intent and accepted bindings survive client loss, transfer and recovery. Procedure phase order is installed, never caller-defined. Reference capsule operations account for their complete supplied capsule bytes and retained history. Workflow cost reports also identify aggregate proposal and evidence bytes transmitted, retained and revisited across every participant, phase and retry. A per-owner linear validation proof establishes only its declared local operation; it cannot qualify end-to-end orchestration. Any implementation of that broader operation must declare its own complete input extent and include replication, all recipients and retries in its linear work proof.

PrepareRequest.description: The complete decoded preparation payload. The selected receiver is a participant and independently approves the immutable initial_driver assignment. A transport caller never implicitly becomes driver. Repeating the exact workflow_id and proposal under current permission returns retained custody, including any transferred driver; changed intent conflicts. Fresh local content, approval and current admission checks precede preparation. Generation starts at zero and initial driver term at one; no child effect is accepted. Before acknowledging initial preparation the receiver signs and retains its exact PreparationWitness in prerequisite_witnesses. That local preparation alone cannot admit children; every distinct owner must attest to the same proposal before first ordinary progress.

TransferCompletion.description: The full independently authenticated commit closure. Every distinct participant owner appears exactly once with state transferred, the original proposal digest and workflow ID. The local witness equals the receiving owner retained commit; another signature, later generation, substitute epoch or omitted owner does not complete this transfer.

AdvanceRequest.description: One immutable advance identity. The receiving owner reauthorizes the actual principal, resolves advance_id and exact retained input before current generation/term or new-input expiry checks, and replays an identical accepted transition without executing it again. Changed input under the same advance_id conflicts. A new request compares the exact local capsule generation and current driver term and follows the installed next phase; it cannot skip phases or revive terminal/recovery-required work. Every prerequisite witness is independently authenticated and checked against its local procedure obligations. When a transfer is pending in commit phase, transfer_completion must contain the complete transferred-witness closure for the exact proposal and the unchanged retained local commit. The owner atomically retains that evidence, marks the transfer completed, records the advance outcome and increments its capsule generation once. Transfer completion must preserve the current procedure phase and exact lifecycle state; subsequent phase progress requires a separate ordinarily authorized advance. It never implies rollback, release of holds or completion of a child operation. An unavailable epoch or incomplete evidence remains unresolved and cannot be replaced by timeout. Driver transfer is orthogonal to lifecycle. Completion preserves the exact prior lifecycle state, including paused and recovery-required. No transfer is permitted to reactivate cancelled or completed work. A successor with recovery preparation not yet committed cannot advance. Before an ordinary phase transition, witnesses plus already retained prerequisites must contain complete authenticated PreparationWitness agreement for all distinct original participant owners. Retain each exact proof; a conflicting proposal digest, replacement local witness or omitted owner fails. A committed recovery successor uses its complete recovery preparation closure for this agreement. Every ordinary advance carries complete phase_evidence under workflow-evidence.schema.json: exact proposal-bound transition, participant native proofs and installed child success barriers. Receiving owners independently authenticate and currently verify that evidence before acceptance; merely bound Plans cannot complete a phase. The same-phase transfer-completion path requires null phase_evidence. This transport input cannot request owner-native authority; every non-null phase proof binds authority driver. New ordinary phase progress requires prepared or active lifecycle; paused work requires a separate independently authorized owner-native resume. Exact accepted advances remain replayable after any later lifecycle restriction. The successful wire result is the original finite MutationAcknowledgment, correlated to advance_id, complete decoded input and committed local generation. Full capsule inspection is a separate workflow.get/list or record.read operation.

InputReference.description: The sole wire input shape for workflow.prepare, workflow.bind, workflow.advance, workflow.transfer and workflow.recover. Complete canonical-JSON payloads are staged through content.begin/chunk/commit under resource {kind: workflow, id: workflow_id}; the RPC carries only this bounded immutable reference. The method owns the payload schema: PrepareRequest, BindRequest, AdvanceRequest, records.WorkflowTransferRequest or workflow-recovery.RecoveryRequest respectively. No caller-selected schema, inline alternate, subset or truncated witness closure is accepted. Verify complete bytes, digest, size, exact owner epoch, protected staging scope and current principal before interpreting the payload. Resolve a previously retained exact semantic request before new-admission expiry checks; original accepted content remains pinned. An authorized replacement caller may restage the identical canonical request: the handle is a transport locator, while the decoded immutable request defines replay identity. New requests require fresh committed custody and independently approved receiving capacity. Chunk bounds do not bound the complete proposal or evidence set. Before acknowledgment the receiving owner authorizes every participant resource it owns and retains the decoded original input plus all needed content. These declarations do not implement staging, native authorization or persistence.

AdapterInput.description: Exact receiving-owner-approved selected executor and complete typed mutation planning input. The executor role equals the request contract and its scope equals request.input.scope. The child Plan adapter_id, adapter_release and action equal the executor instance, installation digest and request method. Its input handle contains canonical request bytes, with matching digest and size; input_schema pins the exact installed role MutationRequest URI and its complete schema closure digest and result_schema pins the same role RetainedResult. The receiver independently checks this binding, method support, configuration, grants and native controlling authority against protected approved enrollment before preparation; supplied identity data never approves or enrolls an adapter. Child admission still requires its own owner-authored Invocation and current authorization. This input does not create or dispatch an effect. installation_digest and adapter_release identify the immutable artifact key used by approved Installation; descriptor and configuration approval are separate protected owner facts.

InitialDriver.description: The immutable initial driver agreement shared by all participant owners. The caller transporting preparation need not be this principal. Each receiver independently authorizes this exact assignment against protected local policy; the proposal is not a delegation grant. Accepted replay preserves the retained driver and any later transfer.

oneOf.description: A later reviewed Plan for this exact subject, after the immediately preceding request on the same participant succeeds with known effects. This declares ordering inside an installed phase sequence, never a caller-defined procedure graph. Fresh Plan preconditions, review and custody are required after the predecessor; initial generations are not reused.

Publish the actual complete ciphertext candidate produced from the exact successful issuer child. The selected publisher is this participant; source, entry, consumer, immutable version, catalogue digest and expected_previous are immutable. The candidate does not exist at preparation and is admitted only with an independently verified ProducedMaterial binding, complete content custody and a new reviewed publisher.publish Plan. This output intent may only be the first request for its participant. Every later request must be a reviewed-successor tied to the immediately preceding successful child, so two output slots cannot bind against one unchanged resource generation.

Adopt only the bundle produced by this workflow exact issuer and publication children. The later Plan pins the real completed publication receipt and retained ciphertext closure, with independently verified producer lineage and local material custody; a preexisting or unrelated receipt cannot fill this intent. This output intent may only be the first request for its participant. Every later request must be a reviewed-successor tied to the immediately preceding successful child, so two output slots cannot bind against one unchanged resource generation.

DeferredBinding.description: An immutable request slot requiring later owner-reviewed Plan binding. It is not a Plan, accepted operation or fabricated material handle. The installed procedure and declared predecessor constrain when it can be bound. A phase cannot finish with unresolved required slots. Secret-output intents are first-only; later participant requests always use reviewed-successor ordering.

ProducedMaterial.description: An independently verified material derivation retained by its receiving custodian. The witness owner equals material.owner, kind binding, state verified, exact workflow ID, and subject_digest covers the complete canonical body excluding witness. For publication, producer is the exact succeeded issuer operation and material is the complete ciphertext candidate derived from its issued credential. For adoption, producer is the exact succeeded publication operation, material contains the complete publication receipt, and that receipt names the exact published candidate and custodian. A receiver independently authenticates this lineage and byte custody before placing it in verified_materials; neither a signature-shaped object nor the request supplies that approval. The issuer-to-publication binding is retained transitively, never replaced by a coincidental receipt digest. producer_output is a verified receiving-custodian copy of the exact non-null Operation result handle bytes, matching digest and size and retained in the new Plan input closure. For adoption it equals material and therefore the canonical receipt is the exact publication Operation output, not another publication of equal ciphertext. Credential-to-ciphertext derivation additionally requires the exact original ProtectedValueHandoff to be available and its receiving owner to have committed original-value custody; an opaque value_handle alone is insufficient. Missing material preserves confirmed native effects and cannot authorize repeating issuance.

BindRequest.description: One exact later-reviewed child binding. The receiver resolves bind_id replay before freshness, checks the immutable slot and installed phase, current driver, authentic complete predecessor evidence and the protected current resource generations, then independently approves the full new Plan. Every material and selected adapter is verified and retained before acknowledgment. Input is staged through workflow-input custody. The binding atomically increments only the local workflow capsule generation and retains its original request; it does not admit native effects. Plan admission still checks current owner/resource generation, deadline and permission. The same child cannot acquire a different Plan. Other replicas retain the same owner-approved binding and producer lineage under their own exact local request identity; transport alone supplies no approval. New bindings require prepared or active lifecycle and are refused while paused, recovery-required or terminal; exact previously accepted bindings remain replayable under current access. Ordinary predecessor Operations must name this workflow in their witness; a CompletedBinding instead requires its exact preserved ancestor operation. The successful wire result is MutationAcknowledgment for the original request and committed generation, not a current Workflow snapshot.

BindReceipt.description: The complete accepted binding request and local committed capsule generation. Retained exact input supports replay after deadline, generation or driver changes; current access remains required. Binding receipts are append-only, unique by bind_id and child, and preserve preceding output lineage. Its finite MutationAcknowledgment is retained with this exact outcome and replayed unchanged; later capsule generation does not change the acknowledged generation.

CompletedBinding.description: A nonexecutable successor slot fulfilled by an exact previously succeeded operation and its original Plan. The new slot identity is a workflow reference, never a new operation request. Original owner epoch, request identity, Plan and outcome remain unchanged. Only workflow.recover may introduce this slot after independently verifying the complete predecessor closure. A fresh prepare cannot turn a supplied receipt into fulfillment. Later continuations use the retained original successful operation as their predecessor evidence. The exact original Operation witness workflow_id is preserved across successors; it is never rewritten to the successor ID. Every later binding, phase and recovery join requires that complete preserved operation rather than ordinary successor membership.

PreparationWitness.description: One finite signed local preparation attestation. Its exact owner epoch is a proposal participant, workflow_id equals the immutable proposal workflow_id and subject_digest equals the complete proposal digest. The owner issues and retains it atomically only after independent full local authorization and durable input custody. A caller cannot manufacture agreement. Before first ordinary phase progress or child admission every distinct participant owner must provide an authenticated attestation for this same proposal; the local witness must remain the exact originally retained one. Complete agreement survives later changes. Recovery successors instead establish agreement through their complete committed current-owner recovery preparation closure.

DriverAdvanceReceipt.description: The original complete accepted driver advance and its immutable finite outcome. authority is driver and the exact request remains an AdvanceRequest. Ordinary phase admission cannot occur during a pending driver transfer; only its separately authorized same-phase completion can close that interval. generation identifies the local atomic transition and stays fixed after later observations or transfers. Exact accepted wire replay returns the original finite MutationAcknowledgment without applying the transition again; current capsule retrieval is separate. Ordinary phase progress is admitted only from prepared or active; paused and recovery-required capsules may only retain same-phase transfer completion, which preserves their lifecycle restrictions.

NativeCompletion.description: An independently retained owner-native completion identity, never a workflow.advance or other transport input. advance_id identifies this native transition and cannot be reused by a driver advance. Exact owner epoch, capsule generation and observed driver term are bound to authority native-owner in complete signed phase evidence. Only the final adjacent installed transition from an active or paused penultimate phase may settle already admitted work. Every required child has independently authenticated succeeded/known outcome and every terminal native obligation is verified. This records completed facts without admitting or executing new work, changing driver or transfer custody, reviving cancellation/recovery-required state, or releasing any hold. The native owner authorizes this protected path independently; client request fields and signatures alone cannot supply that authority. Exact accepted replay retains the original input and outcome before fresh evidence checks while current native authorization remains required.

NativeCompletionReceipt.description: Exact protected owner-native settlement and immutable finite terminal outcome. This is not an accepted driver request. The complete native input and signed authority remain distinguishable through historical inspection and exact replay; transfer proposal, accepted phase inputs, driver identity/term and holds are preserved byte-for-byte.

AdvanceReceipt.description: One retained ordered workflow transition with explicit authority. Driver entries preserve actual accepted AdvanceRequest inputs; native-owner entries preserve independently authorized final settlement; native-lifecycle entries preserve owner-local admission changes. Authority cannot be relabeled or requested by a transport caller. Every form retains original input commitments and finite outcomes, with unique transition identities and strictly ordered capsule generations; no recursive snapshots are stored. Complete phase and lifecycle history must agree with the current capsule; terminal outcomes cannot be relabeled to permit new work.

NativeLifecycleDecision.description: One independently authorized owner-native admission decision, never a workflow.advance or other transport input. The owner serializes this exact decision with local new-child admission and retains its full input, signed witness and outcome atomically. advance_id shares the immutable transition identity namespace with driver advances and native completion; replay under current native authorization precedes new-generation and reconciliation checks. Exact owner epoch, proposal, predecessor lifecycle, procedure phase, generation and observed driver term are bound. The approval witness names the same owner and workflow, generation expected_generation+1, destination state, and subject_digest of this complete decision excluding witness. The native owner independently authenticates the decision and retains any evidence named by its witness. Pause closes new local child admission, binding and ordinary phase progress. Resume is legal only from paused, restores prepared at the initial phase or active thereafter, and requires independently verified current driver authority, reconciliation of accepted children, holds and current permissions, and no incomplete driver transfer. Preparation closure remains required before new children or phase progress. Require-recovery closes ordinary progress until an explicit successor recovery; it cannot be undone by resume or transfer. Cancel irreversibly closes local future child admission from any nonterminal lifecycle, even during incomplete initial preparation or driver transfer. It does not cancel child Operations, establish that participants stopped, undo effects, release holds or inputs, advance the procedure, or change transfer/driver custody. Uncommitted recovery successors use their existing explicit abandonment path. Each participant remains independently authoritative; one local cancellation never certifies global cancellation. Initially prepared participants may cancel locally without complete preparation closure; never-prepared participants require their positive retire-unprepared tombstones to prevent late preparation. All original proposal, child identity, input, evidence, hold and transfer custody survives every decision; cancellation/recovery evidence remains discoverable for explicit recovery. request is null for an autonomous owner-native decision, otherwise it retains the exact LifecycleRequest and actual authenticated principal that triggered consideration. Its request_id equals advance_id and owner, workflow, proposal, generation, driver term and action equal the decision. This attribution never converts untrusted request fields into native authority; the witness covers it with the complete protected decision. An accepted requested decision remains discoverable in workflow history with its original attribution after later lifecycle or driver changes. procedure equals the immutable proposal type and is covered by the witness so a standalone LifecycleResult cannot relabel the installed procedure without changing the signed decision.

NativeLifecycleReceipt.description: Immutable owner-native lifecycle input and finite local outcome in the ordered workflow history. The procedure phase, driver and all custody remain unchanged. State must equal the legal outcome of decision.action from the exact preceding lifecycle state; generation is expected_generation+1. No entry may follow cancellation or completion. Current capsule state must preserve the history outcome, including terminal state, while separately retained recovery abandonment can establish cancellation only without overriding completed history.

LifecycleRequest.description: A finite untrusted request for the receiving owner to consider a local lifecycle decision. It supplies no native authority, signature, actor, reconciliation result or caller-selected from_state/phase. The actual authenticated principal needs current scoped administrator lifecycle permission for a new decision; current scoped read permission is checked before accepted-request lookup and disclosure. request_id shares the ordered transition identity namespace with advance_id: the owner permanently reserves its exact canonical input and authenticated attribution with the emitted decision. Exact accepted replay returns the original decision and outcome before generation, driver, lifecycle and new-decision checks, and may be read by a differently authenticated currently permitted reader; original attribution is never rewritten. A changed input or a native/driver transition under the same identity yields CONFLICT. A new request binds this owner epoch, immutable proposal, current local generation and driver term. The owner independently selects current state/phase, authorizes and signs NativeLifecycleDecision, and atomically retains it with local child-admission changes before success. Resume also independently verifies the retained driver current permission and reconciliation; an administrator request does not supply those facts. A driver transfer is still required to change driver identity. Resume cannot bypass terminal or recovery-required state, uncommitted recovery, incomplete transfer or missing reconciliation. Other actions preserve the native lifecycle rules, including local cancellation during incomplete preparation or transfer. PERMISSION_DENIED refuses missing current permissions, OWNER_EPOCH_CHANGED refuses a different receiver epoch, NOT_FOUND refuses an absent workflow, and PRECONDITION_FAILED refuses changed proposal/generation/term, illegal transitions or unmet native prerequisites. Refusal uses the existing typed Problem and grants no transition; read/reconcile before constructing a separately reviewed new request. A lost or unreadable response is acceptance uncertainty, never evidence of refusal. Discover retained request attribution through workflow.get/list and record.read and replay the same exact request. This path never cancels accepted children, releases holds or invents remote cessation.

LifecycleRequestAttribution.description: Protected actual receiving-principal attribution and the complete original untrusted request, signed as part of the native decision. This object is produced by the receiver and cannot be submitted as request authority. Replays preserve it byte-for-byte even when a newly authorized reader is different.

LifecycleResult.description: The original accepted requested native decision and its local outcome, not a fresh current-state observation or an Operation acceptance. The request_id and request_digest select receipt.decision.request.input exactly; request attribution is non-null. The receipt generation equals expected_generation+1 and its phase/driver term and legal destination match the signed decision under this installed procedure. Every replay returns these same values, preserving the original principal, even after newer workflow transitions. The receiver separately authenticates the native witness; structural checks and a digest do not establish native truth. Witness evidence remains complete and uncapped. When this result cannot fit a wire frame, return an immutable Workflow RecordReference for its complete retained capsule; read all chunks, verify the exact snapshot, select the unique requested receipt by request_id and request_digest, and reconstruct this same result. Never omit evidence or replace the original receipt with current workflow state. Success proves the local admission decision only, never child termination, global cancellation, rollback, hold release or native qualification.

MutationAcknowledgment.description: The finite immutable local acknowledgment for exactly one accepted workflow.bind or workflow.advance. mutation_id is the decoded original bind_id or advance_id, request_digest commits the complete canonical decoded request rather than a staging locator, and generation is that request expected_generation plus one. owner and workflow_id exactly match the request and receiving owner epoch. Before replying the owner independently authorizes the mutation and atomically retains its complete original input, individual outcome, acknowledgment and required material/evidence custody. The same exact accepted request returns this same acknowledgment under current read permission even after later generations, driver changes or deadline expiry; changed input under the identity conflicts. Acknowledgment creation and replay use the individual retained outcome and must not require copying, serializing, hashing or fetching the whole Workflow. workflow.get/list and record.read separately disclose complete retained history; no history, evidence or custody is omitted by a finite reply. Receivers correlate every field with their independently retained request commitment and expected owner before treating this as local acceptance. This record is neither current workflow state, proof of child execution or global completion, native authentication nor permission to execute. A missing reply remains acceptance uncertainty. No full-Workflow or RecordReference alternate is accepted for these two mutation responses. Linear reply-production and correlation work does not qualify full workflow validation, admission, storage or execution growth, which retain their separate requirements.
